question:
The following diagram shows the rainfall over two years. Which of the following months shows the highest percentage change in rainfall?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9829aea1615f71e5c84926f704352529abc56dfd73b4ed889d900f878ba0a846.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

In the given options 

The percentage change in rainfall in January is, {(55 - 35)/35} × 100 = 57.14%

The percentage change in rainfall in March is, {(45 - 25)/25} × 100 = 80%

The percentage change in rainfall in september is, {(25 - 15)/15} × 100 = 66.66%

The percentage change in rainfall in May is, {(75 - 45)/45} × 100 = 66.66%

**March shows the highest percentage change in rainfall.**
